title: Scenario runner: --effort (and --author-effort / --ask-effort) reaches claude --effort and is recorded per turn
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M2 row of its milestone table). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 02:10Z: 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」; 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发". The row quotes the maintainer, 2026-11-15: 「后续统计是否还要加入花费的时间，以及你现在用的effort 分别是什么，需要对照测试吗」.

## Mechanism

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/cli.ts` takes `--model`, `--author-model` and `--ask-model` (lines ~152-154) and no effort flag. `ClaudeCodeDriver` in `runner/driver.ts` builds `['--output-format', 'stream-json', '--verbose', '--max-turns', N]` plus `--model` (~292-293) and passes no `--effort`. So every turn runs at the CLI's default effort, and neither the run record nor the scorecard can say which effort produced a score.

## Why it matters

The maintainer asked which effort each eval ran at and whether effort needs a control test. The model comparison on #33595 cannot separate model from effort until the runner can set it and the record states it. The M2 close-out row "effort control" (eval#1) depends on this card.

## Done when

- `--effort LEVEL` sets both halves, and `--author-effort` / `--ask-effort` set one half each, mirroring the model flags. The runner passes `--effort LEVEL` to the `claude` CLI, accepting the CLI's own level names.
- Each `TurnSummary` records the requested effort. The scorecard shows effort beside the served model on the author row and the Run rows, and the run record carries it.
- `recorded:` refuses the flags, as it refuses the model flags (`LIVE_FLAGS`). `codex` and `external:` either map it or refuse it loudly, measured, not assumed.
- Tests pin the argv the live driver builds and the scorecard cell.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`), serial with the other M2 runner cards where files overlap.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue "--effort" runner` → 530 hits, top ones dispatch-effort process cards (#32023, #31433, #25921) about seats, none about the scenario runner passing effort to the CLI.
